revenue.currentPricingAssessment: Current pricing ($199/mo BASIC) is too high for zero-customer traction. $199/mo is ~5M VND — a significant monthly expense for Vietnamese SMEs and individual creators, especially when customers must ALSO pay for their own API keys (OpenRouter, ElevenLabs, D-ID) on top. Without social proof, case studies, or testimonials, asking $199 upfront creates overwhelming purchase friction. The MASTER tier at $4,999 lifetime is unreachable until the product has proven ROI. Current pricing was designed for scale, not for the 0-to-10-customer bootstrap phase.
revenue.suggestion: Introduce a $0 'Starter' tier with 1 watermarked campaign to build trust and prove value. For the first 90 days, run a 'Launch Special' at $19/mo (BASIC, no watermark) or $1 first month. This matches VN market willingness-to-pay (50k-150k VND/month for SaaS tools). Once 10-20 customers are onboard and generating testimonials/case studies, ratchet pricing toward $49-99/mo for new customers. Grandfather early adopters at launch pricing. EN market can sustain higher pricing ($29-49/mo) from day one via separate pricing track or SKU.

referral.strategy: Two-sided referral program with cash-based incentives for VN market and credit-based for EN market. Referrer gets 1 month free subscription for each paying referral. Referee gets 50% off first month. For VN users specifically, offer cash referral bonus in VND via bank transfer (more motivating than subscription credits in price-sensitive market). Simple referral link in dashboard with tracking. Top referrer each month gets a spotlight feature and 3 months free.
referral.details: Implement a referral endpoint that generates unique referral codes linked to user accounts. On successful payment (confirmed via NOWPayments IPN), credit both parties. VN market: cash payout of 500k VND per successful referral for the first 10 referrals per user (creates urgency to refer early). EN market: 50% of first month's subscription as account credit. Display a 'Your Referrals' dashboard section showing: referral link, clicks, signups, conversions, rewards earned. Launch with email invite + social share buttons pre-filled with referral link.

top3Priorities: Launch a $1 first month promotional pricing + instant demo video on signup — remove ALL financial and psychological friction to becoming a paying customer. This is the single highest-leverage move to get from 0 to 10 customers.

Aggressive VN Facebook + Telegram outreach through partner group admins (revenue share model) — target 3-5 groups with 10k+ members each. VN market is the fastest path to warm leads because faceless YouTube + affiliate marketing is a proven, popular topic in Vietnamese online business communities.

Build a free Starter tier with 1 watermarked campaign — lets prospects validate the product's value before paying. The current $199/mo minimum is the #1 blocker: no one pays $199 for a product they have never seen work. A free tier is standard SaaS growth practice for exactly this reason.
